title: Forensic-grade audit pipeline: residency-aware WORM bundler and automated evidence exports
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Scope: Build a hardened pipeline that collects admin/admin-access/config-change audit events, normalizes them into a canonical forensic bundle, seals each bundle with tamper-evident digests (hashchain), and writes bundles to WORM-backed storage respecting customer data residency and retention policies. The pipeline must support automated periodic export of signed evidence manifests (for legal/incident response) and ad-hoc forensic pulls, with RBAC and auditability of the retrievals.

Goals: 1) Guarantee append-only storage with cryptographic proof for every sealed bundle. 2) Ensure bundles are stored in the customer-designated residency region and honor retention TTLs and legal hold flags. 3) Provide automated reporting and export endpoints for compliance teams (SRE/Legal/Customer Security). 4) Integrate with Console rollout so admins can configure residency and retention per-customer and view evidence issuance traces.

Non-goals: Not responsible for long-term cold storage lifecycle policies beyond TTL+legal hold; not implementing new SSO providers in this ticket.

Constraints & trade-offs: Using cloud provider immutable containers provides operational simplicity but creates cross-region replication challenges; selected design uses regional WORM buckets with signed manifests replicated to a central ledger service (metadata only) to avoid moving sensitive content across boundaries. We will favor deterministic hashchains (SHA-256) for interoperability and auditable proofs over experimental schemes that would delay delivery.

Security considerations: Keys for signing manifests will be stored in KMS/HSM per customer where available. All read/export requests must be logged in the same audit fabric and require a justification field and RBAC check.
acceptance_criteria: Audit events for admin actions (console/login/as-admin/config-changes) are ingested and normalized within 60s in the pipeline
Bundles are sealed with a verifiable hashchain and the hash is recorded in an append-only metadata ledger
Sealed bundles are written to WORM-backed storage in the configured residency region and cannot be deleted before TTL unless legal_hold flag is set
Automated daily evidence export job produces signed manifests and deposits them to a customer-accessible export location with an audit trail
Console UI shows per-customer retention and residency configuration and a timeline of evidence-seal events
Security review approved and signing keys provisioned via KMS for staging and prod
tasks: Design schema for canonical audit bundle (events payload, metadata, retention tags, region tags)
Implement ingest normalization service with idempotent dedup and region tagging
Create sealer component that computes bundle digests and emits ledger entries
Provision regional WORM buckets and integration tests for append-only enforcement
Build automated export job with signed manifest generation and S3/GCS deposit paths
Console integration: add residency/retention controls and evidence timeline panel
E2E tests including legal_hold behavior, TTL expiration, and export retrieval logging
Run security review and KMS key rollout for signing service
